title: Console backend: rollout timeline + gate evidence + action availability endpoints (Dedicated staged rollouts)
author: Chloe Martin
release_notes: Internal-only: adds Console backend endpoints powering Dedicated staged rollout timeline and gate evidence panels; includes RBAC-gated action availability (promote/abort/hold) and audit-friendly responses.
description: Summary: This PR adds Console backend endpoints needed for the Dedicated staged rollouts UI: (1) a stage timeline feed (including current stage, history, and state machine fields), (2) gate evidence retrieval for the currently-evaluated stage (and optionally for prior stages), and (3) action availability for promote/abort/hold based on rollout state, gate status, and caller RBAC. Motivation: Console UI currently relies on stitching together control plane plan data + telemetry + policy engine decisions, which is brittle and inconsistent across regions. The goal here is to provide a stable Console contract that matches the rollout state machine semantics and produces deterministic, auditable output with explicit “why” fields. Scope: DedicatedPoolRolloutPlan-backed rollouts only (reserved pools). No general experiment platform behavior. The endpoints are read-heavy and designed to be safe under telemetry lag; missing data is represented explicitly so the UI can render “unknown/stale” states and guide operators. Key points: 1) New endpoints (admin + customer console) - GET /console/v1/dedicated/pools/{pool_id}/rollouts/{rollout_id}/timeline: returns ordered stage timeline entries plus rollout summary (state, active_stage, requested_stage, hold_reason if any). - GET /console/v1/dedicated/pools/{pool_id}/rollouts/{rollout_id}/gates/evidence?stage_id=...: returns gate-by-gate evidence, including query window, observed values, thresholds, pass/fail/unknown, and reason strings (e.g., “insufficient samples”, “telemetry stale”, “policy engine evaluation error”). - GET /console/v1/dedicated/pools/{pool_id}/rollouts/{rollout_id}/actions: returns available actions + required permissions + blocking reasons (e.g., “rollout is aborted”, “gate evaluation pending”, “hold requires dedicated_rollouts:write”). Note: action execution endpoints (promote/abort/hold) are handled by the control plane service (PRs 28458/28592); this PR is strictly Console backend read layer + policy. 2) Data sources and determinism - Timeline: sourced from control plane rollout plan state machine fields + audit events stream (for “who promoted/aborted/held and why”). - Gate evidence: sourced from policy-engine evaluation output (preferred) with a fallback to the telemetry query runner for debug-only fields; output explicitly indicates data_source=policy_engine|telemetry_fallback and includes staleness markers. 3) RBAC and customer visibility - Customer admins can view timeline and gate evidence for their own pools; action availability only indicates what they can do (no leaking of admin-only overrides). - Hold is exposed to internal operators by default; customer hold visibility is read-only (they can see “held” and the customer-safe reason, but cannot set/clear hold unless allowlisted via feature flag and role). 4) Observability + audit friendliness - Responses include request_id, evaluated_at, evaluation_window, and stable “reason codes” intended for audit logs and support triage (e.g., GATE_MISSING_DATA, GATE_STALE_DATA, GATE_THRESHOLD_BREACH, ROLLOUT_STATE_BLOCK). - Adds structured logging on endpoint handlers with pool_id, rollout_id, actor_type (customer|operator), and elapsed_ms. 5) Feature flagging - Endpoints are guarded by dedicated_staged_rollouts_console_read for customer traffic and dedicated_staged_rollouts_admin_read for internal tooling. Default off. API examples (trimmed): Timeline response sketch: {"rollout_id":"rpl_...","pool_id":"dp_...","state":"RUNNING","active_stage_id":"stage_10","stages":[{"stage_id":"stage_01","target":"1%","status":"COMPLETED","promoted_at":"2025-02-27T18:10:12Z","promoted_by":"user:ethan.park"},{"stage_id":"stage_10","target":"10%","status":"ACTIVE","started_at":"2025-02-27T18:26:44Z"}],"events":[{"type":"PROMOTE","stage_id":"stage_10","at":"2025-02-27T18:26:44Z","actor":"user:ethan.park","reason":"canary looked good"}]} Gate evidence response sketch: {"stage_id":"stage_10","evaluated_at":"2025-02-27T18:31:00Z","window":"5m","gates":[{"gate":"p95_latency_ms","observed":182,"threshold":220,"status":"PASS"},{"gate":"error_rate","observed":0.006,"threshold":0.01,"status":"PASS"},{"gate":"gpu_oom_rate","observed":null,"threshold":0.001,"status":"UNKNOWN","reason":"telemetry stale: last_sample_age=9m"}]} Action availability response sketch: {"actions":[{"action":"PROMOTE","available":false,"blocked_by":["GATE_UNKNOWN"],"required_permissions":["dedicated_rollouts:write"]},{"action":"ABORT","available":true,"required_permissions":["dedicated_rollouts:write"]},{"action":"HOLD","available":true,"required_permissions":["dedicated_rollouts:admin_write"],"customer_visible":true}]} Testing: - Unit tests for timeline assembly (audit + plan state ordering), gate evidence formatting (unknown/stale/insufficient samples), and RBAC filtering. - Integration tests using the staged rollouts simulator fixture (mock policy engine responses + delayed telemetry). - Added contract tests for the Console UI schema expectations (stage statuses, reason codes). Rollout plan: merge behind feature flags; dogfood via admin console first. Follow-ups: - The UI evidence panel bug in SUP-28605 was caused by telemetry tag mismatch; this PR makes missing evidence explicit and surfaces “tag mismatch suspected” hints when policy engine returns UNKNOWN but telemetry fallback sees samples without stage_id labels. - Force-promote and admin override semantics are in PR-28592; this PR already reserves reason code slots for OVERRIDE_* but does not expose the action. Risk: Moderate (Console contract changes). Mitigation: Feature flagged, additive endpoints, no changes to existing console endpoints; careful cardinality controls in logs and no raw query strings returned to customers.

review_conversation: Jordan Lee: Can we avoid calling telemetry directly from Console backend? We want policy engine to be the single source of truth for gate evaluation.

Chloe Martin (author): Agreed. Updated so telemetry is only used as an internal-only fallback for debugging and is never the default. The response includes data_source and we redact raw query strings for customer callers.
Allison Grant: Please ensure we do not explode cardinality in logs/metrics. Stage IDs can be high-cardinality in some customer plans.
Chloe Martin (author): Addressed: endpoint metrics are tagged only by route + actor_type. Structured logs include rollout_id/pool_id but those are sampled at 5% and excluded from metrics labels.
Kaitlyn Nguyen: RBAC: customer admins should not see operator-only hold reasons, and action availability must not leak the existence of admin overrides.

Chloe Martin (author): Implemented customer_safe_reason vs internal_reason. Also action availability is filtered to caller permissions; customers see HOLD state but not admin_write requirement details.
Logan Wright: For UNKNOWN gates due to staleness, can we include last_sample_age and a consistent reason code? Helps oncall triage.
Chloe Martin (author): Added last_sample_age_seconds and reason_code=GATE_STALE_DATA. UI can render guidance (“telemetry delayed”).
Jada Williams: Timeline ordering: promotions should be derived from audit events, not inferred from stage timestamps, otherwise retries can reorder in edge cases.

Chloe Martin (author): Updated assembler: audit events are the primary ordering; timestamps used only for display when event missing. Added a regression test for duplicate promote events with idempotency retries.
Jordan Lee: Approval after the fallback behavior change and redaction.
Kaitlyn Nguyen: Approved with note to re-review customer-visible hold semantics in PR-28592.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main by Jada Williams. Squash commit: 8c2e6f1a6d (console-backend: rollout timeline + gate evidence endpoints).
